market_news.paragraph: Global equities were mixed in the latest completed round of trading, with 13 of the 24 benchmarks tracked on this page closing higher. In the United States, the S&P 500 fell 0.47 per cent to 7,765.36, the Dow Jones rose 0.10 per cent to 51,232, the Nasdaq Composite fell 1.25 per cent to 27,193 and the Russell 2000 was little changed at 2,794.13. In Europe, the FTSE 100 fell 0.16 per cent to 10,442, the DAX fell 1.18 per cent to 24,807 and the CAC 40 fell 0.51 per cent to 7,729.69. Across Asia, the Nikkei 225 was little changed at 69,031, the Hang Seng rose 1.62 per cent to 24,171, the KOSPI fell 2.62 per cent to 6,625.93, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.27 per cent to 3,822.03, the BSE Sensex rose 1.05 per cent to 72,344 and the Straits Times fell 0.13 per cent to 5,405.84. Elsewhere, the Ibovespa rose 0.94 per cent to 206,220. Locally, the S&P/ASX 200 rose 0.64 per cent to 8,716.60 and the All Ordinaries rose 0.62 per cent to 8,877.70. In digital assets, bitcoin changed hands at $82,518, down 0.39 per cent over the past 24 hours. In currencies, the US dollar bought 1.4402 Australian dollars, up 0.11 per cent against the prior business day's fix. Index levels, exchange rates and commodity prices on this page are captured live at build time from the sources linked in each section; no forward-looking view is offered here.
